dct_description_sm: There are three goals to this project. First, we are validating the use of blood dried on filter-papers as a suitable method for collecting samples from the field for the purpose of PCR-based diagnostics of blood-borne pathogens. Second, we are establishing baseline prevalences and distributions of these four pathogens in several wild Rangifer herds in North America and Greenland. Finally, we are genetically characterizing the strains of pathogens we detect and comparing them to strains from other North American ungulates.
dct_title_s: Serological survey for infectious diseases in Rangifer herds in North America and Greenland
